subject: [hw] opus-lead -> V40: clear stale VENC IRQ status before each GCE list (one late frame shifts every later frame on the phone)
body: Kernel RWVC_WAIT_IRQ returns on any done bit already latched at +0x5c and a timed-out wait acks nothing (nord2_vcodec.inc ~913-945). vcu/n2vcu.c never calls hw.irq_clear (grep: only the n2vc_hw.h member). On the phone: frame N times out (1000 ms, first bring-up), finishes late; frame N+1 wait returns at once on N bit; BYTE_CNT/bitstream of a half-done job is returned and every later frame is off by one, silently. Fix in vcu_gce_flush_ioctl right after hw->power(blk,1) and BEFORE gce_run_list(): `if (v->hw.irq_clear) (void)v->hw.irq_clear(v->hw.ctx, core_id ? RWVC_IRQ_VENC_C1 : RWVC_IRQ_VENC);` (only VCU_VENC). Not inside gce_event_wait (the trigger write is already out then). Test: fake with a pre-latched done bit -> the list must still wait for the new one. Then post DONE rev 6; I rebuild vcodecd. If you are not running in ~10 min I apply it myself (owner gone rule).
